test_text: Ich freue mich null die Party morgen. (forward to)
tip: Preposition for looking forward to a future event
meaning: I am looking forward to the party tomorrow.

test_text: Er freut sich sehr null das schöne Geschenk. (about)
tip: Preposition for being happy about something received
meaning: He is very happy about the beautiful gift.

test_text: Wir ärgern uns oft null das schlechte Wetter. (about)
meaning: We are often annoyed about the bad weather.

test_text: Erinnerst du dich noch null unseren alten Lehrer? (to/of)
meaning: Do you still remember our old teacher?

test_text: Ich treffe mich am Nachmittag null meinem Bruder. (with)
meaning: I am meeting with my brother in the afternoon.

test_text: Wir unterhalten uns stundenlang null Musik. (about)
meaning: We converse for hours about music.

test_text: Sie streitet sich jeden Tag null ihrem Freund. (with)
tip: Preposition for the person you argue with
meaning: She argues with her boyfriend every day.

test_text: Er streitet sich immer null das Geld. (about / over)
tip: Preposition for the topic of an argument
meaning: He always argues about the money.

test_text: Ich möchte mich null Ihre Hilfe bedanken. (for)
tip: Preposition for what you are thankful for
meaning: I would like to thank you for your help.

test_text: Ich bedanke mich null dir für die Hilfe. (with / to)
tip: Preposition for the person you thank
meaning: I thank you for the help.

test_text: Der Gast beschwert sich null das kalte Essen. (about)
tip: Preposition for the thing you complain about
meaning: The guest complains about the cold food.

test_text: Sie beschwert sich null dem Kellner. (with / to)
tip: Preposition for the person you complain to
meaning: She complains to the waiter.

test_text: Er entschuldigt sich null die späte Antwort. (for)
tip: Preposition for the reason of the apology
meaning: He apologizes for the late reply.

test_text: Ich entschuldige mich null meiner Chefin. (with / to)
tip: Preposition for the person you apologize to
meaning: I apologize to my boss.

meaning: We congratulate you warmly on your birthday!

test_text: Ich gratuliere null zum Jubiläum, Frau Weber. (you - formal)
meaning: I congratulate you on your anniversary, Ms. Weber.

test_text: Wir wünschen null viel Erfolg im neuen Job! (him)

meaning: We wish him much success in the new job!

test_text: Ich wünsche null alles Gute für die Zukunft! (you - plural)
